exports: Generated implementation: configured ABI traits::JsonEncode::encode_json(&self, &mut dyn ByteSink) -> error::Result<()> for named and unit structs
test_vectors: Complete deterministic generated-source vectors for empty objects and a required boolean field; repeated rendering produces identical source.
All eight ScalarType variants select their frozen AOT writer for required and optional fields. U32 and I32 widen exactly through From; strings are borrowed; Decimal128 is copied unchanged.

Optional presence guards contain the separator, key, colon, and value writes. All eight presence combinations for three optional fields exercise empty objects and leading, middle, and trailing omissions.
Declaration order is retained across skipped fields and optional gaps, independently of alphabetical key order; no trailing separator is emitted.

All-skipped generic structs emit only object delimiters, with no field access, Default requirement, allocator reference, or schema bound. Present values are never compared with Default or filtered for emptiness.
Lifetimes, type parameters, const generics, and existing where clauses with trailing commas or surrounding whitespace are preserved without additional bounds.
Configured ABI/AOT paths and raw identifiers remain intact. Generated local names avoid const generic names, skipped field type expressions, raw identifiers, and configured paths.
Wire keys containing quotes, backslashes, control characters, NUL, Unicode, line separators, and token-injection text remain Rust string literals passed to the JSON string writer.

Malformed slot layouts report the offending field for missing indices, gaps, duplicate indices, u32::MAX in a non-dense position, and skipped fields consuming slots. A 65,537-field vector crosses the u16 boundary without truncation.
Every fallible delimiter, separator, key, colon, and scalar write propagates through ? before subsequent output; errors are neither remapped nor discarded.

Full-width integer, finite-float, negative-zero, and exact decimal policies are delegated to the canonical typed writers without casts, formatting, rescaling, or proof construction. These are source-generation assertions, not executed runtime numeric boundary tests.
status: complete; production encoder and 16 inline tests authored and manually reviewed; tests not executed; no cargo, rustc, rustfmt, build, check, test, or git commit commands run; only the assigned source and report were written; generated encoding targets the frozen AOT Wave 3 writer API
